notes.title: Update news
notes.notes:
We have left Early Access after 5 months!
It means a stable state, but we will release new updates. The game’s name has been changed to 3D Mahjong Worlds, because it's not VR only game anymore.

List of the recent updated changes: 
- Adjustable mouse sensitivity settings for non VR mode 
- Night scenes
- Achievements 
- Global leaderboard, which you can find at the menu scene 
- Added 2 new tile graphics sets
- Adjusted difficulties, to make it more fair
- Help hint only works in Easy difficulty
- Adjusted sound effect volumes
- Option to disable Auto shuffle in the settings
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Fist update pack!
notes.notes:
While we were busy making “VR Mahjong World” to be playable without a VR Headset in the previous update, now we were focusing more on polishing content and fixing bugs:
-	Added 2 new locations
-	More detailed graphics on the existing locations
-	Path shows theme of maps on level selection screens
-	User interface improvements
-	Bug fixes
